name: bahamut-anime-ad-skipper
description: Chrome MV3 extension that skips ads on ani.gamer.com.tw without tripping its anti-adblock.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run copy-static
scripts.copy-static: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json popup.html dist/ && cp -R icons dist/icons && cp dist/main-world-channel.js dist/main-world-channel.main.js
